name: ide-toml
author: lumine-code
description: Provide TOML language intelligence through Tombi.

serverPath.title: Server Path
serverPath.description: Absolute path to a native tombi executable. Leave empty to use the editor's managed copy, then PATH.

notifyWhenMissing.title: Notify When Missing
notifyWhenMissing.description: Show the language-server installation notification when Tombi cannot be found.

offline.title: Offline Mode
offline.description: Disable remote schema and package lookups. Local schemas remain available. Changing this restarts Tombi.

tomlVersion.title: Fallback TOML Version
tomlVersion.description: TOML version when a document has no project configuration, schema or version directive. Default leaves the choice to Tombi.

formatterLineWidth.title: Fallback Formatter Line Width
formatterLineWidth.description: Preferred line width for documents without a project Tombi configuration. Zero leaves the choice to Tombi.

schemaAssociations.title: Fallback Schema Associations
schemaAssociations.description: JSON schemas for documents without a project Tombi configuration. Use absolute schema paths or URLs; include values are file glob patterns.

items.title: Schema Association
items.description: Associate a JSON schema with matching TOML files.

path.title: Schema Path
path.description: A JSON schema URL or absolute local file path. Use tombi.toml for paths relative to the project.

include.title: Include
include.description: File glob patterns served by this schema.

features.title: Features
features.description: Which Tombi capabilities the editor uses. Disable one to hand it to another provider for the same document.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Report TOML syntax, lint and schema validation problems.

autocomplete.title: Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: Complete schema keys, values and package metadata.

hover.title: Hover
hover.description: Show descriptions, expected types and dependency details.

definition.title: Go To Definition
definition.description: Follow schema types and supported package or path definitions.

references.title: Find References
references.description: Find references in supported Cargo and Python project manifests.

symbols.title: Symbols
symbols.description: Expose document keys and tables to navigation and outline views.

format.title: Format
format.description: Format TOML using the project's Tombi rules.

codeActions.title: Code Actions
codeActions.description: Offer Tombi corrections and package manifest actions.

inlayHints.title: Inlay Hints
inlayHints.description: Annotate supported dependency versions and inherited Cargo values.

semanticTokens.title: Semantic Tokens
semanticTokens.description: Layer Tombi's semantic highlighting over the TOML grammar.
